package nats

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const validCoursePlanOutcome = `{
  "event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type":"course.plan.completed",
  "correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "causation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
  "occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z",
  "schema_version":1,
  "data":{
    "request_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
    "goal_code":"go.backend",
    "status":"COMPLETED",
    "result_code":"COURSE_ASSIGNED",
    "course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
    "reused":false,
    "failure_code":"",
    "source":"TEACHER",
    "reason":"INITIAL",
    "audit_refs":{"dialog_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"}
  }
}`

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcome(t *testing.T) {
	outcome, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(validCoursePlanOutcome))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, outcome.EventType)
	require.Equal(t, "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", outcome.CourseID)
	require.Empty(t, outcome.LearningPathID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher, outcome.Source)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeV2CompletedWithLearningPath(t *testing.T) {
	payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",`, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","learning_path_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",`, 1)
	outcome, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", outcome.LearningPathID)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsNonCanonicalPath(t *testing.T) {
	base := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1)
	canonicalPath := "abcdefab-cdef-4abc-8def-abcdefabcdef"
	for _, path := range []string{
		" ", "", "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777 ",
		strings.ToUpper(canonicalPath),
		strings.ReplaceAll(canonicalPath, "-", ""),
		"{" + canonicalPath + "}",
		"abcdefab-cdef-4abc-8def-abcdefabcde",
	} {
		payload := strings.Replace(base, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",`, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","learning_path_id":"`+path+`",`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, path)
	}
	withNull := strings.Replace(base, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",`, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","learning_path_id":null,`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(withNull))
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsNonCanonicalEnvelopeIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, field := range []string{"event_id", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id"} {
		payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"`+field+`":"`, `"`+field+`":"{`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, field)
	}
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsOversizedPayloadAndCodes(t *testing.T) {
	oversized := strings.Repeat(" ", maximumCoursePlanEventBytes+1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(oversized))
	require.Error(t, err)
	for _, field := range []string{"goal_code", "result_code"} {
		payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"`+field+`":"`, `"`+field+`":"`+strings.Repeat("A", maximumCoursePlanCodeBytes+1), 1)
		_, err = DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, field)
	}
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRequiresExactProducerWireValues(t *testing.T) {
	base := validCoursePlanOutcome
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		field string
		from  string
		to    string
	}{
		{"event type whitespace", "event_type", "course.plan.completed", " course.plan.completed "},
		{"event type uppercase", "event_type", "course.plan.completed", "COURSE.PLAN.COMPLETED"},
		{"goal whitespace", "goal_code", "go.backend", " go.backend "},
		{"goal uppercase", "goal_code", "go.backend", "GO.BACKEND"},
		{"status whitespace", "status", "COMPLETED", " COMPLETED "},
		{"status lowercase", "status", "COMPLETED", "completed"},
		{"source whitespace", "source", "TEACHER", " TEACHER "},
		{"source lowercase", "source", "TEACHER", "teacher"},
		{"reason whitespace", "reason", "INITIAL", " INITIAL "},
		{"reason lowercase", "reason", "INITIAL", "initial"},
		{"result whitespace", "result_code", "COURSE_ASSIGNED", " COURSE_ASSIGNED "},
		{"result lowercase", "result_code", "COURSE_ASSIGNED", "course_assigned"},
	}
	for _, testCase := range cases {
		payload := replaceCoursePlanWireValue(base, testCase.field, testCase.from, testCase.to)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, testCase.name)
	}

	failed := strings.Replace(base, `course.plan.completed`, `course.plan.failed`, 1)
	failed = strings.Replace(failed, `"status":"COMPLETED"`, `"status":"FAILED"`, 1)
	failed = strings.Replace(failed, `"result_code":"COURSE_ASSIGNED"`, `"result_code":""`, 1)
	failed = strings.Replace(failed, `"failure_code":""`, `"failure_code":"INVALID_GRAPH"`, 1)
	for _, value := range []string{" INVALID_GRAPH ", "invalid_graph"} {
		payload := strings.Replace(failed, `"failure_code":"INVALID_GRAPH"`, `"failure_code":"`+value+`"`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, value)
	}
	completedWithoutResult := strings.Replace(base, `"result_code":"COURSE_ASSIGNED"`, `"result_code":""`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(completedWithoutResult))
	require.Error(t, err)

	for _, timestamp := range []string{"2026-09-01T12:00:00+00:00", "2026-09-01T12:00:00.1234567890Z", " 2026-09-01T12:00:00Z"} {
		payload := strings.Replace(base, `"occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z"`, `"occurred_at":"`+timestamp+`"`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, timestamp)
	}
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeAcceptsPlannerNanosecondsAndGoalPunctuation(t *testing.T) {
	payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z"`, `"occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00.123456789Z"`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `"goal_code":"go.backend"`, `"goal_code":"goal/v1+β:пр"`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func replaceCoursePlanWireValue(payload, field, from, to string) string {
	return strings.Replace(payload, `"`+field+`":"`+from+`"`, `"`+field+`":"`+to+`"`, 1)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeV2FailedWithBoundedFailureCode(t *testing.T) {
	payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `course.plan.completed`, `course.plan.failed`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `"status":"COMPLETED"`, `"status":"FAILED"`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `"result_code":"COURSE_ASSIGNED"`, `"result_code":""`, 1)
	payload = strings.Replace(payload, `"failure_code":""`, `"failure_code":"LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT"`, 1)
	outcome, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.CoursePlanStatusFailed, outcome.Status)
	require.Empty(t, outcome.LearningPathID)
	require.Equal(t, "LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT", outcome.FailureCode)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsUnknownField(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","event_type":"course.plan.completed","correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","causation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z","schema_version":1,"unexpected":true,"data":{}}`)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsUnknownVersion(t *testing.T) {
	payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":3`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsV1PathAndMalformedPath(t *testing.T) {
	v1WithPath := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",`, `"course_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","learning_path_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(v1WithPath))
	require.Error(t, err)
	v2WithMalformedPath := strings.Replace(v1WithPath, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1)
	v2WithMalformedPath = strings.Replace(v2WithMalformedPath, `77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777`, `not-a-uuid`, 1)
	_, err = DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(v2WithMalformedPath))
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsMalformedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	identities := []struct {
		field string
		value string
	}{
		{"event_id", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"},
		{"correlation_id", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"},
		{"causation_id", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"},
		{"student_id", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"},
		{"request_id", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"},
		{"course_id", "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"},
	}
	for _, identity := range identities {
		payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"`+identity.field+`":"`+identity.value+`"`, `"`+identity.field+`":"not-a-uuid"`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, identity.field)
	}
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsMalformedFailureCode(t *testing.T) {
	base := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"schema_version":1`, `"schema_version":2`, 1)
	base = strings.Replace(base, `course.plan.completed`, `course.plan.failed`, 1)
	base = strings.Replace(base, `"status":"COMPLETED"`, `"status":"FAILED"`, 1)
	base = strings.Replace(base, `"result_code":"COURSE_ASSIGNED"`, `"result_code":""`, 1)
	for _, failureCode := range []string{"", "not-a-code", strings.Repeat("A", 65)} {
		payload := strings.Replace(base, `"failure_code":""`, `"failure_code":"`+failureCode+`"`, 1)
		_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
		require.Error(t, err, failureCode)
	}
	completedWithFailure := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"failure_code":""`, `"failure_code":"INVALID_GRAPH"`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(completedWithFailure))
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsForbiddenPlannerPayload(t *testing.T) {
	payload := strings.Replace(validCoursePlanOutcome, `"audit_refs":{`, `"generated_course":{"private":"checkpoint"},"audit_refs":{`, 1)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome([]byte(payload))
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDecodeCoursePlanOutcomeRejectsStatusSubjectDrift(t *testing.T) {
	payload := []byte(`{"event_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","event_type":"course.plan.failed","correlation_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","causation_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","occurred_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z","schema_version":1,"data":{"request_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","goal_code":"go.backend","status":"COMPLETED","result_code":"","course_id":"","reused":false,"failure_code":"","source":"SYSTEM","reason":"REPLAN","audit_refs":{}}}`)
	_, err := DecodeCoursePlanOutcome(payload)
	require.Error(t, err)
}
